pages.text: Place a $(item)Storage Nexus$() beside chests or barrels, then right-click it.$(br2)Compatible storage within $(bold)5 blocks$() appears automatically. Discovery can take a few ticks.$(br2)Extend coverage with $(item)Relay Crystals$(). They connect automatically within 16 blocks of same-channel network crystals.

pages.title: Shared storage
pages.text: Nearby containers supply the list. Linked Nexuses share storage.

Relays, Storage Nexuses, and Storage Crystals connect automatically. Several paths can coexist.$(br2)Ordinary links reach $(bold)16 blocks$(). Endpoints must be loaded and share a dye channel. Dye separates nearby networks.$(br2)The Nexus also relays transfers. Breaking one path uses another if available.
